## Summary

## Read-only and compatibility review

- [ ] Public upstream APIs; no copied domain parsers
- [ ] Approved text fields, configured roots and bounded structured output
- [ ] No project mutation, execution, binary or spatial/gridded reads
- [ ] Subagent routing and Python handoff retained
- [ ] Declared minimum/current library versions considered
- [ ] Wheel/sdist metadata and entry points reviewed

## Evidence

Do not claim engine/host/Windows verification from synthetic Linux results.
